newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 24.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones fell 94.28 points to 6,755.75 PLDT's ADR also dropped $0.50 to $58.50.
* On Thursday, the peso weakened to 26.336 a U.S. dollar from 26.325.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,328.38, up 52.55.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate was steady for the 13th day at 10.53215 percent.
* Ayala Corp and Benpres Holdings Corp won the two concession contracts to operate and manage the Metropolitan Waterworks and Sewerage System.
* Philippine National Bank reports a 17 percent decline in its 1996 net income to 1.708 billion pesos from 2.05 billion pesos a year ago.
* The Securities and Exchange Commission orders the freezing of share prices of Itogon Suyoc Mines Inc A and B after five days of sharp rises.
* Lopez-owned Bayan Telecommunications Holdings Corp and Ayala-controlled Globe Telecom forge an interim interconnection agreement to link the two companies' networks. (BUSINESSWORLD)
